description: This file defines a feature for creating a new user in the Conduit application. It includes a command, validation, and handler logic for processing user registration requests, including checks for username and email uniqueness, password hashing, and token generation.

classes.name: Create.UserData
classes.description: Data record holding user registration details: Username, Email, Password.

classes.name: Create.Command
classes.description: Command object encapsulating user data for registration, implements IRequest for async handling.

classes.name: Create.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates the Command to ensure Username, Email, and Password are provided.

classes.name: Create.Handler
classes.description: Handles the registration process: checks for existing username/email, hashes password, saves new user, and generates JWT token.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Main execution method that processes user creation, including validation, database interaction, and token creation.
